target_behavior_plan: The revised reward converts the repeatable action_0_bonus into a one-shot event-gated bonus that is paid only once when the lander first achieves a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. This prevents farming of the bonus without task completion. The success_bonus is increased to 300 to make it clearly distinguishable from proxy rewards and provide a stronger terminal signal. The angle_penalty is reduced to avoid discouraging necessary orientation engine use. The progress-delta shaping terms remain to guide the lander toward the pad.
action_coverage_plan: All discrete actions (0,1,2,3) are already used. The action_0_bonus is converted to a one-shot event-gated bonus, so the policy will still use action 0 when it achieves the stable near-pad state, but it will not farm the bonus repeatedly. The policy must learn to use action 0 during the final approach phase to achieve the one-shot bonus and then the success bonus.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (descent): The progress-delta shaping encourages the lander to move toward the pad and reduce vertical speed. Phase 2 (final approach): The progress_bonus and action_0_bonus (one-shot) encourage the lander to achieve a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. Phase 3 (landing): The success_bonus (300) provides a strong terminal signal for completing the task.
payment_mode_plan: The progress-delta shaping is paid every step based on the change in distance and velocity. The progress_bonus is a one-shot event-gated reward paid only once when the lander first achieves a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. The action_0_bonus is now a one-shot event-gated reward paid only once when the lander first achieves a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting (same condition as progress_bonus, but separate bonus). The success_bonus is a terminal reward paid only on successful termination. The crash_penalty is a terminal penalty paid on failure termination.
